github-lifecycle.name: GitHub Lifecycle
github-lifecycle.description: Plan and apply audited GitHub Issue Field lifecycle operations.
github-lifecycle.author: Lean Full-Lifecycle Contributors

tools.name: git
tools.why: transition_plan.py runs `git -C <root> diff --name-only HEAD` to compare the board against the working tree. Without it the audit's working_tree_disagreement rule cannot run; every other rule still does.

python_packages.name: PyYAML
python_packages.why: Every policy file is YAML, and reading policy is what these scripts do.

python_packages.name: jsonschema
python_packages.why: Validates a readiness verdict, outcome record, discovery note, and disposal decision against its declared schema. Without it those four are accepted on shape alone.
